outcome.root_cause: The test sorts the ETSI reference cluster delays but compares them elementwise with native Sionna delays in source-table order. The cluster power and angle arrays remain aligned with native delays; the subsequent characteristic sums are permutation invariant. The elementwise order assertion therefore rejects equivalent cluster rosters before evaluating any statistical acceptance claim.

scope: Records an invalidated test implementation attempt only. It is not a G4 acceptance result and establishes no channel-family conformance.
